evidence.name: Screen field: Internal note (optional)
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Internal note (optional)" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Internal note (optional)
sections.description: An optional internal note explaining what this variable is for. It only shows as a tooltip in the editor when you hover the variable later — visitors never see it and it has no effect on the funnel. A one-line note like "visitor's primary fitness goal" is worth adding so you and teammates remember the variable's purpose when reusing it across screens.
